title: aura_visual
summary: MSUI now resolves every active aura's state SpellVisualKit through a per-unit AuraVisualState. The verified CharProc dispatcher admits proc 14 alpha, proc 1 packed-RGB tint, and proc 11 animation rate; nodes are keyed by spell, link newest at the head, and removal reveals the next head. Effective opacity is CreatureModelAlpha/255 times one head alpha factor and moves over the reference one-second clamp(t)^3 ramp in both directions. Body shaders apply alpha/tint to the local body, streamed players/creatures, attached equipment, and mounts; a translucent body forces opaque/cutout batches onto straight-alpha blending with depth writes disabled. Rate zero pauses local, remote, and mount animation clocks without freezing attached state-effect models or global sequences. Focused tests cover node ordering, packed tint, cubic retarget/reap, display-only alpha, base-times-head composition, shader/runtime fences, and the actual mounted DBC values for Ghost Wolf 4613, Stealth 1784, and Ice Block 11958. Build and full interface checks pass; authenticated visual verification remains.

openItems.text: Proc 14 translucency: no aura-driven body alpha at all (no stealth/invisibility/ghost fade; grep for stealth/translucency/CreatureModelAlpha in the render stack finds nothing).
openItems.resolution: AuraVisualState installs proc-14 alpha nodes by spell, uses newest-head authority, composes one factor with display base alpha, and drives the exact one-second cubic ramp; body/gear/mount shaders consume the result through the blend path.

openItems.text: Proc 1 tint: no aura-driven body color modulation.
openItems.resolution: Proc-1 packed 0x00RRGGBB values decode to a head-owned normalized body tint and modulate local/streamed bodies, attached gear, and mounts without easing.

openItems.text: Proc 11 anim-rate: no freeze of the unit's animation clocks under Ice Block/Petrify-family auras.
openItems.resolution: Proc-11 rate zero pauses the unit and mount clocks for the aura lifetime while leaving attached state-effect models and global sequences running; non-zero rates remain recorded but do not invent a clock conversion.

openItems.text: Base display alpha: CreatureDisplayInfo's CreatureModelAlpha is not applied, so authored-translucent displays (Ghost Wolf) render opaque.
openItems.resolution: CreatureDisplayInfo field 5 is retained as ModelAlpha and resolved for every unit display; display-only translucency ramps from opaque on first observation and display swaps retarget the same alpha channel.

openItems.text: In an authenticated session, visually verify Stealth/Prowl alpha ramps on self and observed units, Frostbolt/poison/ghost tints, Ice Block pose hold and thaw, Ghost Wolf base alpha, overlapping head-node replacement, and body/gear/mount composition without depth-write artifacts.
